summary: hooks/statusline.py main() reads sys.stdin with the default UTF-8 decoder inside a try that catches only JSONDecodeError and OSError, so non-UTF-8 bytes on stdin raise UnicodeDecodeError and the hook exits 1 with a traceback instead of failing open and printing a status line (reproduced on main: printf '\xff\xfe{"model":1}' | python3 hooks/statusline.py -> exit 1). Pre-existing on main, not introduced by the usage taper change c79a35661f9c; found while fixing the same class of bug in tools/usage.py read().
